change_reason: Replace an overly linear platform-layer representation with composable platform planes while preserving MetaCore category, scoped authority, runtime 2.6 and evidence boundaries.
frozen_invariants: MetaCore OS = Operating, Context & Control Core; Layer remains a public compatibility alias.
Products compose platform capabilities; products are not platform infrastructure planes.
Integration Fabric and Execution are distinct.
Security, Evidence and Economy are cross-cutting planes.
AI Persona and Agent remain distinct; fixed B1 concurrency counts require measured evidence.
Model providers are replaceable intelligence sources; MetaCore continuity is provider-neutral.
KR are internal service credits, not money/crypto/cash-out/automatic FX.
Unknown/hypothetical/metaphysical material may orient inquiry but cannot self-promote to verified fact or action authority.
Dignity is universal; authority is scoped.
Private Team LAB remains opaque from base_core; only reviewed minimal derivatives promote into base_core.

compatibility.runtime: 2.6 adaptive co-creator runtime remains unchanged by this architecture-category patch.

change_control.allowed: correctness, evidence, security, domain closure, runtime polish, documentation alignment that preserves V2 invariants
change_control.requires_architecture_v3: new top-level platform plane, authority-basis change, product/infrastructure collapse, autonomous execution authority, weakening evidence or privacy boundaries
